## This week

One chapter, two halves of one subject. A finished output can be fed back into the attempt so the next version is better — reflection (Self-Refine on one output, Reflexion across attempts, and the external-feedback condition that decides when self-correction works at all) — or scored against a fixed standard so change itself becomes measurable — evaluation (evalsets, code grading, LLM-as-a-judge and its biases, error analysis, regression). The lecture also draws the line students most often blur: ReAct's Thought versus reflection.
